limitations: Restricted to depth-two labelled Sierpiński graphs, capacities between one and m-1, and minimum-cardinality sets. Exact enumerators for larger r remain coefficient-extraction formulas. Historical priority for alternative formulations has not been exhaustively established.
scientific_integrity: Fully stated family proof; exact finite test script is corroboration rather than the argument for the infinite family. The minimum-size formula for capacity one was already established in the primary cited source. No general depth greater than two or independent historical-priority claim is made.
title: Extremal \(k\)-limited domination of depth-two Sierpiński graphs as symmetric regular binary matrices
